obsidian_context.summary: Executing the 2026-08-12 EaseForward + Esteban organic recovery roadmap. A live crawl-depth audit found the site's pricing and quote surfaces orphaned from ordinary navigation in both locales, which the roadmap's internal-link objective directly targets.

hard_stops_checked.pricing_or_offers: not touched — the calculator and diagnostic pages themselves are unchanged; only links to them were added
hard_stops_checked.factual_business_claims: not added — the only new copy is six navigation labels and two group headings derived from the existing page titles
hard_stops_checked.deployment: not performed by this change; Vercel preview built automatically from the PR branch

builder.evidence: One file changed (components/site-footer-client.tsx, +16 lines). A new group was appended to englishGroups and spanishGroups using the existing {href,label} item shape rendered by FooterList, so no component, type, or styling change was required.

skeptic.evidence: All six hrefs were checked against the live sitemap and all six already exist, so the change adds no indexable URLs and cannot violate the roadmap publishing freeze. The indexable-inventory-freeze test passes unchanged. Routes were confirmed to return HTTP 200 with real page titles before being linked, so these are not dead links.

taste.evidence: The new group reuses the existing FooterList heading and link styling verbatim. Labels are plain descriptors taken from each page's own title rather than promotional phrasing, and the Spanish group uses native labels rather than literal translations of the English ones.

reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: No disagreement. The one point raised was whether a conversion-oriented footer group risks reading as promotional; it was resolved by keeping labels descriptive (Budget calculator, Video strategy diagnostic, Script & safe-zone kit) with no pricing, urgency, or outcome language.
winner_rationale: The footer was the correct surface because it already carries the site-wide navigation groups in both locales and is rendered on every page, so linking there fixes reachability for the whole inventory in one place rather than editing individual leaves. The header was rejected because it is a short primary nav and adding three entries per locale would crowd it.
